name: SafeOrStolen AI
description: AI-powered consumer protection platform. SafeOrStolen AI is a conversational verification assistant that verifies whether secondhand items are stolen by checking IMEI numbers, VIN numbers, serial numbers, and firearm serial numbers against 100+ law enforcement, insurance, and carrier databases. Includes AI smart identifier detection, AI scam scoring, AI marketplace URL analysis, and AI visual OCR. 2 free checks, results in 3 seconds. Then $0.99/check or $10/month unlimited.
softwareRequirements: Modern web browser; AI-powered verification features
